newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FIORENTINA CLOSE IN ON KANCHELSKIS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIORENTINA CLOSE IN ON KANCHELSKIS.

text.p: English premier league side Everton look set to sell Russian striker Andrei Kanchelskis, despite rejecting an initial bid of $9.6 million from Italian club Fiorentina

Everton manager Joe Royle confirmed Fiorentina's interest on Wednesday, saying any deal would depend on Kanchelskis, signed from Manchester United for 5.5 million pounds ($8.9 million) in August 1995.
"Fiorentina have been told our asking price. It depends on whether the player wants to leave the club to move abroad.," said Royle.
The Gazzetta dello Sport newspaper quoted Fiorentina managing director Luciano Luna as saying that Kanchelskis had already agreed his own terms with Fiorentina and a contract to the year 2001.
"Kanchelskis has always been one of our targets," said Luna. "We made Everton a serious offer on Monday night.

"We are waiting for a reply and hope to conclude the deal by January 30. That way Kanchelskis could play immediately. But we are also willing to buy the striker after that date. He interests us for the present and also the future."
Italy's domestic transfer deadline is January 30.
Fiorentina are ninth in the League but still in the Cup Winners' Cup. They won the Italian Cup last season and briefly challenged Milan for the league lead before fading later on.

Milan have reportedly also expressed an interest in Kanchelskis, although not until next season. Tuttosport said on Wednesday that if the Fiorentina offer broke down, the Ukrainian-born winger was likely to join Milan in June.
